arguments.prompt: List all files under /workspace recursively (depth 3). Then, for any .md file containing the text "Power Systems", run: grep -nE "dramatically|significantly|[Rr]obust|leverages|paving the way|seamless|crucial|holistic|landscape|Navigat|Integral|integrated set|essential|unprecedented" on it, and also print with `sed -n l` or `cat -A` a few lines to reveal non-ASCII bytes. Report results as plain text.
